market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to remain range-bound to slightly lower. Oil volatility from Middle East tensions and Qantas strike vote create near-term headwinds. CSL.AX US deal provides a sector-specific positive. Iron ore weakness caps materials. Property credit stress weighs on banks. Expect 2-3% downside risk to ^AXJO over 1-3 months.
market_outlook.long_term: 6-12 month outlook cautiously constructive if RBA eases on domestic inflation and property credit stabilises. Critical minerals and coal provide structural support. CSL US deal and GLP-1 demand support healthcare. Key risk: global debt spiral and AI-driven productivity disruption could trigger a broader correction. Diversified miners and quality dividend payers preferred.
